sentences.text: The Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maan-dhan Yojana (PMLVMY) is a government welfare scheme aimed at providing social security to small traders and self-employed individuals.
The objective of the scheme is to provide a pension of Rs. 3,000 per month to eligible beneficiaries after they reach the age of 60 years.
The scheme benefits small traders and self-employed individuals by ensuring a steady income post-retirement.
Eligibility criteria include being a small trader or self-employed individual with an annual turnover of less than Rs. 1.5 crore.
Applicants must be between the ages of 18 and 40 years at the time of enrollment.
The application process involves filling out a form available at designated centers or online through the official portal.
The scheme provides a monthly pension after the age of 60 for those who have contributed to the scheme during their working years.
The implementing authority for this scheme is the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.
Additional details include that beneficiaries are required to make a monthly contribution to the scheme based on their age at the time of enrollment.
